description: Calibration certificate vs intended use: range, uncertainty and validity — Checks whether an instrument's calibration certificate covers an intended measurement, for an agent about to rely on a reading or accept a calibrated device. intervalMonths.description: Calibration interval when no due date is printed.

max.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

min.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

uncertainty.description: Expanded uncertainty over this range, absolute, in `unit`.

validUntil.description: Due date on the certificate, inclusive.
